description: Next run times (in UTC) of a standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday; ranges, lists, steps and names like MON or JAN supported). Use to check a schedule before deploying it. Example: expr=*/15 9-17 * * MON-FRI, count=5, from=2026-10-19T08:00:00Z. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: cron_next
